paper_title: MADLLM Multivariate Anomaly Detection via Pre-trained LLMs
caption: figures/ablation_title.pdf
model_annotation: This bar chart illustrates F1 scores across several datasets for different MADLLM model configurations. The horizontal axis represents the dataset, labeled "Dataset," and contains the categories SMD, PSM, SWaT, SMAP, MSL, and WADI, listed in that order from left to right. The vertical axis is labeled "F1 Score (%)" and displays values ranging from 60% to 100% in increments of 10%, with tick labels for each increment. There are six groups of bars, each representing a different MADLLM configuration: MADLLM, MADLLM w/o feature embedding, MADLLM w/o prompt pool, MADLLM w/o skip embedding, and two others that are not labeled. The color scheme is green for MADLLM, purple for MADLLM w/o feature embedding, blue for MADLLM w/o prompt pool, and pink for MADLLM w/o skip embedding. For the SMD dataset, the MADLLM configuration has an F1 score of approximately 96%, with a range across configurations between approximately 74% and 96%. The WADI dataset has the lowest F1 scores, with the MADLLM configuration registering around 73%, and the lowest measured score being about 68%. The bars are not sorted numerically or in any other apparent order, and there is no visual emphasis on any individual bar.
